instance.name: SafeRefresh application association positive; separate from R26 running example

metadata.business_setting: one CME exchange information set, designed display-subscription planning abstraction; no bundling across exchanges, non-display use or redistribution-right inference
metadata.common_period: one designed planning period; no mapping to real billing month
metadata.eligibility_status: designed nested scenario: low may access L,M; high may access L,M,H; not a recovered customer entitlement matrix
metadata.price_grid_role: legacy Instance field required for schema only; continuous-price PHT and fixed-menu pricing do not enumerate this grid
metadata.quality_status: common cardinal coefficients are designed; not estimated from release seconds, prices, or fees

source_constrained_configuration.constraint_role: defines feasible release-class configuration and its documented order; it is not a numerical profit coefficient
source_constrained_configuration.information_scope: same abstract information set, separate first-provision/first-access contract alternatives; no downloaded trade data

metadata.tie_rule: theta=0 exits; otherwise maximize utility incl outside, then price, then quality, then product index
metadata.units: synthetic model profit units per common planning period; not USD
